summary: Stage 3 reopened because the builders' 0.2.0 commits changed tree.json and scenes.json (12d6c0feab, d420ae2e45, 6e78fea88e). The packet's carried 'missing decision' (the 19 coverage gaps of 2026-11-12) is stale: those gaps were reworked in later rounds, and coverage passed on his word on 2026-11-13 (d_owner_pass_on_his_word). Lint (Gate A) passed unchanged. The one stage-3 refusal: the 14 inventory bars of 0.2.0 were covered by no showcase and no scene. Repair, on the Pyrelands 0.2.0 precedent: (1) scenes.json gets the 8 built 0.2.0 lane scenes as acceptance scenes. Each cites the 0.1.0 leaf that its parent scene decides, with bars_0_2_0 naming the record.json bars it decides. Each carries its start, its control from its own plants and its restore. (2) The blast show is showcase 2 (sc_blast_show plus sc_settings_sweep_show_switches): 9 new capabilities, 0 overlap. (3) The other 5 lane bars go in coverage_rest. Showcase set accepted. (4) sc_pawn_arc's stale 0.1.0 'holds the same stack in flight' clause is corrected to the 0.2.0 carried_thing_own_arc. (5) All 36 owner words that the packet listed are cited: 13 go to existing decisions and 4 to new decisions (walk frame against mod-off, goods into the pit first, the lit chemfuel ruling, the big-blast whoosh), and 20 are owner_elsewhere_reviewed with a reason; uncited is now 0. (6) plan.md answers offline simulation: yes, the shipped kernel against a model map. (7) version/next_version/README.md gets the chemfuel and whoosh entries; neither moves a 0.2.0 bar. The tree is not touched: it is locked and owner-certified, so the 0.2.0 bars stay record.json inventory rows, as dc_open_0_2_0 wrote them. Stage 4 must retake the exam on the changed scenes.
